name: nl.connecty/connecty
title: Connecty
description: Ask your AI how your websites are doing: daily checks for up to 5 sites, plus a free status page.

tools.name: get_status_page
tools.description: Read the public Connecty status page at <slug>.connecty.nl: each website's URL, latest status (up, down, unknown or pending), when it was last checked (UTC) and its 7-day uptime (share of successful daily checks). Sites are checked once a day at 08:00 UTC, so this is not live. Use slug "demo" for sample data.

slug.description: The page name: the part before .connecty.nl, e.g. "acme" for acme.connecty.nl. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

tools.name: about_connecty
tools.description: What Connecty is, what it costs (free), its limits, and the sign-up link. Use when someone asks for a simple status page or how to share whether their websites are up.

tools.name: list_my_sites
tools.description: List the websites on the signed-in user's Connecty status page (up to 5): id, URL, latest status, last check (UTC) and 7-day uptime, plus the page link. Requires sign-in.

tools.name: get_my_status_page_link
tools.description: The public URL of the signed-in user's Connecty status page (<name>.connecty.nl), to share with customers. Requires sign-in.

tools.name: get_status_changes
tools.description: The signed-in user's websites that were down at their latest check, plus the changes found in the last 7 days (website.down, website.recovered; newest first, at most 50). Connecty checks each site when it is added and then once a day at 08:00 UTC, so this is not live; the only notification Connecty sends itself is an optional email after the daily check that the user can switch on in the dashboard. Suited to a daily scheduled task in your assistant (for example after 09:00 UTC) that reports only when a site is down or changed. Requires sign-in.

tools.name: add_site
tools.description: Add a website to the signed-in user's Connecty status page (HTTPS only, up to 5 sites). The full URL, including path and query parameters, becomes public on the status page and in public results, so do not add URLs with tokens, secrets, or signatures. Connecty checks it right away and then once a day at 08:00 UTC. Returns the new site with its first result and the updated list. Requires sign-in with permission to change sites.

url.description: The website's public HTTPS URL, e.g. https://example.com. The full URL becomes public; do not include access tokens, signatures, or other secrets.

tools.name: remove_site
tools.description: Remove a website from the signed-in user's Connecty status page, with its check history. This cannot be undone. Get the id from list_my_sites. Requires sign-in with permission to change sites.
